overview_description.description: REPROSENT helps patients collect and use their own symptom data to achieve better outcomes. Using a mobile app to accurately capture what is happening between visits, an AI-based triage system, and a report to guide appointments, symptoms and toxicities aren’t missed and treatment success is improved all while reducing the burden on clinical teams.
